title: Presidents not told unless, like Bush 41, they were CIA director

tellings.quote: So unless you're George H.W. Bush, Bush 41, who is director of the CIA as the president of the United States, you probably don't even know

plain: US presidents are probably not even told about the hidden programmes that are said to study non-human craft, unless, like George H. W. Bush, they once ran the CIA before taking office. David Grusch, who appears on the show as a witness to these matters, says this to Michels, passing on what he has been told. If true, it would mean the people who keep the secret answer to no elected leader.
